protocol.graph_policy: every official neuron and aggregate edge retained
protocol.state_policy: reset only between runs; never reset between phases
protocol.scope: one-seed pilot; no fitted decoder, behavior or biological validation
protocol.analysis: onset 50 ms and later ipsi-minus-contra DNa02 Hz; new recovery tail spikes
protocol.selection_policy: report all eight runs; no automatic gain or decoder selection

models.rows_are: neuron-pair/neuropil aggregates, retained as parallel weighted edges
models.weight_policy: 0.05 mV/contact; GABA/GLUT negative, others/unknown positive; no normalization
